rationale: spec-driven-development 1.0.1 replaces the fallback YAML parser in scripts/spec_flow.py with a strict one (quoted scalars, refused flow syntax, duplicate keys, bad indentation and control characters) and adds two tests. The bundled internal/spec/scripts/spec_flow.py already carries this parser: its scalar and parse_simple_yaml functions are byte-identical to e9c04b6, and tests/spec covers the same refusals, so no engine change is needed. Local 1.4.0 change in the actual-diff integration: snapshots.py records gitlinks (path and commit) without copying content instead of refusing any tree with a submodule (other unusual modes are still refused), and run_engine.capture_verification refuses a staged or captured gitlink change with submodule_changed, before any snapshot or spec-engine state change, because the actual-diff review cannot inspect submodule content. README.md and PROVENANCE.md updated.
reviewer: Independent read-only review of release/1.4.0 (commits b277b27..8f615d1) on October 2, 2026: PASS for the upstream diffs (orchestrate wording and SCRIPT_VERSION; factory factory-small wording, nothing vendored; spec scalar/parse_simple_yaml AST-identical to e9c04b6), submodule handling (rename, type change, added gitlink and a non-ASCII path probed), gate timeouts (bool, float, string, 0, 3601 and None refused; precedence explicit > planned > 300), records and lock (upstreams.py status ok) and versions. It raised one finding, fixed in a follow-up commit with its tests: staged_gitlink_changes used git diff-index --cached, which obeys submodule.<name>.ignore=all, so a gitlink move in such a repository passed the early check; the call now passes --ignore-submodules=none. A separate error-path review found no defect (an old run.json without timeout, old snapshots without a gitlinks key, a refusal leaving run.json unchanged). Independent re-review of the follow-up commit d0f11dd on October 2, 2026: PASS. The flag closes the gap (also against -c diff.ignoreSubmodules=all); both new tests fail with the flag removed (mutation run) and pass with it; the record texts are true; upstreams.py status ok, make check exit 0, tests.test_snapshots and tests.test_rich_integration 21 OK.
